labels: When you sit at the Center Table!

nodes.text: She hurls the pillow through the air! It flips end-over-end, slicing through the air like a knife...
`Foomp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Foomp![/b]

nodes.text: It hits the huge girl right in the face... She teeters, then falls!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes! I threw that at just the right time!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I won! I won!
Tina and Beth step onto the field...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah, by cheating!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What? How did I cheat?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: You had helpers!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You mean, the girls I `recruited` to help me? Girls who could be potential OMG sisters?
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, the girls I [color=#3b78e2][i]recruited[/i][/color] to help me? Girls who could be potential OMG sisters?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: She has a point...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Fine. I hadn't thought of it that way... You won.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: And that means you're becoming a standout sister, Paula!
Tina and Beth leave to help the fallen girls. $ZOE and Taylor turn to Paula...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Evidence against Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. What do I care?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Look, Jessica couldn't operate a computer to save her life, so she needed a nerd who wouldn't have any problems going against you guys...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What nerd is that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I already know... It's the same nerd Paula used when she tried to steal the Prom Queen Tiara from me...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Steph` from Wilson High!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Steph[/i][/color] from Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: If anyone's got evidence against Jessica, it's her...
Moments later, on the car ride to Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is it! We're going to finally take Jessica down and give her what's been coming to her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Calm down, Captain Optimist! That's only if we get Steph to cough up evidence against Jessica... `If` she even has any!
nodes.text_bbcode: Calm down, Captain Optimist! That's only if we get Steph to cough up evidence against Jessica... [color=#3b78e2][i]If[/i][/color] she even has any!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We can do it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know you're, like, obnoxiously positive, so I feel like I have to remind you that we don't have very much time to do all of that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, I forgot... I hope Denni's stalling Ben's Inauguration...
A second later, the huge girl wallops Paula, sending her sprawling!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE and Taylor walk over to Paula's prone body, her face buried in the grass...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't suppose you'd consider helping us out anyway, would you?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: `Mmmff! Mmmmf!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Mmmff! Mmmmf![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you see how hard we tried, though? That's gotta count for something!
Paula rolls over, glares at $ZOE, her mouth filled with tufts of grass.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I see... You know what? Never mind.
As $ZOE and Taylor walk away...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess that's it, then. We failed.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `We` failed?! If anything, `you` failed!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]We[/i][/color] failed?! If anything, [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] failed!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... I was just trying to make myself feel better...
Unfortunately, Taylor is right...
Zoe has failed...

nodes.text: $ZOE throws the pillow through the air, but it falls well short of the huge girl...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That wasn't even close!
$ZOE throws the pillow through the air, but it falls well short of the huge girl...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That wasn't even close!
She hesitates!
Out of time, $ZOE takes just three more steps... And...
$ZOE keeps running forward! The huge girl's pillow poised to strike!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I'm still too far away!
$ZOE and Taylor stand back-to-back, fighting their way through the girls. At last...
They tag team a brunette, using their pillows like a set of cymbals on her head.
`Foomp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Foomp![/b]

nodes.text: She falls!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We did it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think that's the last of them!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But, wait... Where's Paula?
$ZOE looks back to the tree... Paula is fleeing from her hiding spot toward them, a huge girl lurching after her, and gaining ground!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!
$ZOE sprints toward them, cocking her pillow-arm back as far as she can...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not yet...
$ZOE does nothing, but Taylor hears the girl coming and does a cartwheel out of the way! As the girl lumbers by, Taylor snatches the pillow from her hands!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yoink!
Before the girl can react, Taylor takes her down with a quick swipe!
Taylor looks at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Seriously? Not even a warning?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I got scared!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, at least we've both got pillows now!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor! Behind you!
$ZOE whips the pillow over to Taylor, who catches it, whirls, and smacks the bigger girl with an arcing attack across the mouth.
`Foomp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Foomp![/b]

nodes.text: The girl stops in her tracks, stunned, and collapses! Feathers fill the air where she once stood.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, that's right! Level 47 Ranger! Ogres 'N' Elves!
$ZOE picks up the bigger girl's pillow.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now we have two!
Just then, a much bigger girl comes charging out of the crowd, right at Taylor!
$ZOE ducks, putting her face right in the path of the pillow!
`FOOMP!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]FOOMP![/b]

nodes.text: $ZOE teeters but manages to stay upright!
As the girl moves in for a final hit on $ZOE, Taylor sneaks up from behind and taps the girl on the shoulder! She spins around toward Taylor!
While the girl's distracted, $ZOE takes her pillow, and hits her in the back of the head with it!
The girl falls forward!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're lucky I'm here! You know that the goal is `not` to get hit, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: You're lucky I'm here! You know that the goal is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] to get hit, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know...
$ZOE catches the pillow in mid-air and wrests it from the petite girl's hands!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry about this... But today's not the day to mess with me!
$ZOE winds up and clobbers the girl with the pillow, knocking her to the ground.
$ZOE looks at Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've got a pillow now!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I noticed!
$ZOE hesitates and the pillow slams into her ribs!
$ZOE freezes!
The pillow collides with the side of $ZOE's face!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE stumbles, barely managing to maintain her balance.
When she looks back at the petite girl, she's already swinging the pillow at $ZOE, right at her ribs!
$ZOE ducks! The pillow wooshes just over her head, the momentum causing the girl to lose her balance!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Phew!
The petite girl weakly swings the pillow back at $ZOE's ribs!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whatever, $ZOE! You're just distracting me from my 'find evidence against Jessica' brainstorm!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...
Taylor tries to come up with another plan...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sigh... You know, I'd think a lot better if I had a soda and a bag of those cheesy puff snacks that Brendan always eats...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Denni, go get me a soda!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What? No! You go get your own soda!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you don't get me a soda, I won't hesitate to demote you to the bottom of the cheer pyramid... Right next to $ZOE here!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh... Cheer pyramid?
Suddenly, Taylor perks up...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I know how to get evidence on Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You totally turned me back into, like, the `old` me, Denni! That was amazing!
nodes.text_bbcode: You totally turned me back into, like, the [color=#3b78e2][i]old[/i][/color] me, Denni! That was amazing!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I try.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, that was `my` idea...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, that was [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] idea...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whatever, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Focus, girls! Taylor, what's your plan?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, well, Jessica's been crazy devious, right? But she wasn't always like that! So what happened? How do you quickly improve at something?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Practice?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kindness?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh... Coaching! She had a coach! And who's someone more devious than Jessica... Someone older... Someone who jumped at the opportunity to help Jessica dethrone me as Head Cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gasp! You don't mean...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's right... `Paula!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's right... [color=#3b78e2][i]Paula![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Her?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... Who's Paula again?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Is this from before Spirit Week? 'Cause that was before our time...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sheesh, you guys! Know your history! Paula was Head Cheerleader before me, and, like, way worse!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh huh. Back then, you had to cheer uphill, in the snow, both ways.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Very funny. I hope your skinny jeans expand in the sun and get all baggy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We don't have time for this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've got to get the evidence against Jessica before Ben's Inauguration!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll never have the attention of the entire student body the way we will tonight... And once Ben's sworn in, Jessica will use her power to bury any calls for impeachment...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The Inauguration is in a couple of hours!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'll stay behind and try to stall the event! You guys try to find Paula!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's on! This is totally going to work!
Twenty minutes later, $ZOE and Taylor are wandering around the Centerscore University campus...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's off! This isn't going to work...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How are we going to find Paula on this `huge` campus? She could be anywhere!
nodes.text_bbcode: How are we going to find Paula on this [color=#3b78e2][i]huge[/i][/color] campus? She could be anywhere!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Or...` She could be right over there, hiding behind that tree!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Or...[/i][/color] She could be right over there, hiding behind that tree!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's back on! I knew this was going to work!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Easy there, Mood Swing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But why is she hiding? And wearing pajamas? And holding a pillow?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Pssht! Who cares? Let's just find out if I'm right about her helping Jessica!
$ZOE and Taylor march over to Paula...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Paula!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Taylor?! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We need to talk... Right now!
Paula grabs Taylor and $ZOE and pulls them to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Idiots!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We know you've been helping Jessica!
Paula peers around the tree out across a nearby field...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I stopped helping that witch months ago!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You `were` right, Taylor!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]were[/i][/color] right, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do you have any evidence against her?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I don't... But I know someone who does...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Like I'd tell `you!` I was dispensing expert advice on taking you down `for a reason,` Taylor!
nodes.text_bbcode: Like I'd tell [color=#3b78e2][i]you![/i][/color] I was dispensing expert advice on taking you down [color=#3b78e2][i]for a reason,[/i][/color] Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Jessica's going to ruin the school!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Pfft! Do you think I care, No Name?!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Look, I know you've got your petty high school drama to deal with and that seems `really` important to you right now, but it isn't!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I know you've got your petty high school drama to deal with and that seems [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] important to you right now, but it isn't!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: This is college, okay? Things actually matter here! Like me winning just `one` of these stupid hazing challenges!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is college, okay? Things actually matter here! Like me winning just [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] of these stupid hazing challenges!

nodes.text: Nearby, two girls walk out to the middle of the field...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Last OMG sorority underclassman standing doesn't have to do dishes for the rest of the week!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Good luck!
Beth trills on a whistle!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: `Pillow fiiiiiiiiiiiiiight!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Pillow fiiiiiiiiiiiiiight![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Pillow fight?
Just then, dozens of pajama-clad girls pop up from hiding places all over the campus! In an instant, the field is filled with screams, flying feathers, and girls slamming each other with pillows!
$ZOE turns to Paula!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If we help you win the pillow fight, will you tell us who has evidence against Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Ha! `You're` going to win this? You're like the size of the dog I carry in my purse!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! [color=#3b78e2][i]You're[/i][/color] going to win this? You're like the size of the dog I carry in my purse!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it's not the size of the dog in the purse that matters...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's the size of the purse in the dog?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She knows what I mean! Do we have a deal, Paula?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: If you win, I win! And if you lose, I watch you get pummeled! Of course we have a deal!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, Taylor!
$ZOE drags Taylor out from behind the tree!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great going! We don't even have a pillow!
Just then a petite girl charges at them and swings a pillow at $ZOE's head!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? You're suggesting that Howard's leaving because he doesn't like me?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, I thought he was leaving because he's graduating...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He is... I just... Got confused...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's on my mind, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But the point is... No one likes you, Taylor! And everyone likes me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Gasp! You did `not` just say that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Gasp! You did [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] just say that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The people spoke, and they like `me,` Taylor!
nodes.text_bbcode: The people spoke, and they like [color=#3b78e2][i]me,[/i][/color] Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's why... What? That's why you can't think of anything because `everyone` likes me?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not what I meant...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What I've been trying to say is... No one likes you, Taylor! That's why...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uhhhh... First off, that's where `all` the cool people sit!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uhhhh... First off, that's where [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] the cool people sit!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And hello?! `You` sit there!
nodes.text_bbcode: And hello?! [color=#3b78e2][i]You[/i][/color] sit there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I guess we're both cool then...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What is wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This isn't working!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Since when did `you` get so judgmental?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Since when did [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] get so judgmental?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Brendan is, like, really good for me, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, that was kind of harsh, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just have to keep making Taylor mad... Even though it's so uncomfortable for me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uhh... `Cooler...` Because you already `are` cool!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What is wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This isn't working!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought you were cool, Taylor. But I guess you can't be cool...

options.label: When you sit at the Center Table!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't understand what that has to do with...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Dye my hair?! At least my hair isn't perpetually obscuring my vision, Miss Inferiority Complex!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Inciting Taylor doesn't feel good...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But this is exactly what I wanted!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm not sure I get the connection...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Only ugly people can be devious?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Seriously? Buzzkill much?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't mean to compliment Taylor! I'm just not good at being mean! Guess I'll try again!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... You know, kept trying?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't mean to encourage Taylor! I'm just not good at being mean! Guess I'll try again!
When she opens her eyes again, she sees Taylor staring at her wide-eyed, standing in front of the mirror...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shut. Up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I didn't know you had that in you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't either!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let me guess... Jessica?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've got to take her down, Taylor! She might have beat us in the election, but I'm not done fighting!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I was thinking the exact same thing... And `not` because I lost to Ben... But because all day I've been hearing people say that they voted for someone else!
nodes.text_bbcode: I was thinking the exact same thing... And [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] because I lost to Ben... But because all day I've been hearing people say that they voted for someone else!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If so many people didn't vote for Ben, how did he win by a landslide?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Something smells fishy...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It does smell fishy in here. It's kinda gross. Probably the fishsticks from the kitchen coming in through the ventilation system...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I meant with the election!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, well, yeah!
At that moment, Denni bursts into the bathroom, slams the door behind her, closes her eyes, and...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: When she opens her eyes, she sees $ZOE and Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes! She's the worst! You guys are fed up with her too?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a rapidly growing club...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How'd she get to you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I was going over the voting trends for this article I promised Jessica I'd write for her...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Don't` ask. It's a favor from a long time ago...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Don't[/i][/color] ask. It's a favor from a long time ago...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Anyway, the numbers just didn't make sense!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The vote was in a dead heat all the way to the end... And then right before the polls closed, a ton of votes for Ben poured in!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sure Jessica rigged the election somehow, but I don't have any evidence.  So instead of exposing her, I'm doing the exact opposite...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: She's got me writing a fluff piece about how amazing she and Ben are!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know. Kill me now, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys, we need to get evidence against Jessica! Otherwise, she's going to make all our lives miserable!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great plan, $ZOE! Let's just head on down to the evidence store and pick us up a big old bag of evidence!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry! Do you have a better idea?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Naturally! We could write, like, a computer program that analyzed everything that Jessica's done up to now! The computer will lead us right to the evidence!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: A computer program? Really? I didn't think I'd be saying this... But `evidence store` sounds like the most plausible idea.
nodes.text_bbcode: A computer program? Really? I didn't think I'd be saying this... But [color=#3b78e2][i]evidence store[/i][/color] sounds like the most plausible idea.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine! That wasn't perfect, but how about this idea? We `role-play` as Jessica. Then, we'll, like, know how she thinks!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! That wasn't perfect, but how about this idea? We [color=#3b78e2][i]role-play[/i][/color] as Jessica. Then, we'll, like, know how she thinks!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I assumed you already thought like her, but that's becoming less and less certain the more you speak...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, I used to be so good at being devious... What happened?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's it! That's the key! Taylor's gotten too nerdy to scheme the way Jessica does!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If only I could somehow trigger the `old` Taylor, I bet `she` could come up with a better plan!
nodes.text_bbcode: If only I could somehow trigger the [color=#3b78e2][i]old[/i][/color] Taylor, I bet [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] could come up with a better plan!

nodes.text: $ZOE takes a deep breath...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry for what I'm about to say, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, Taylor, maybe you'd be better at being devious if you...
$ZOE has failed...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE holds in her anger once again. Her eye twitches. Somewhere inside her brain, several important neurons short circuit.
Taylor's there, staring at her...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I was expecting something a lot more dramatic.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was too!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you just going to stand there staring at me with that weird face or are you going to say something?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... Did I not say that? Sorry, Taylor... What I meant to say was...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're freaking me out, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I can't speak!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I can't say 'Ohmygosh' anymore!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, that's it, game's over!
Taylor storms out past $ZOE and out of the restroom.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why can't I speak?!
Later, $ZOE tries to talk to Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you okay, $ZOE? Taylor said you were acting weird.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if I'm okay! I can't speak!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa! You're just standing there, staring at me... It's really creepy! Say something!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know! I'll write about what's happening!
$ZOE gets out a pen and a paper and tries to write what she's thinking...
But no words come...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Unfortunately, that outburst comes too late for anyone to notice...
Looks like $ZOE is doomed to a life where nothing is ever communicated and everything is held deep inside her...
You shouldn't hold your feelings in forever!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It won't be that bad...
After school, the cheerleaders meet in the auditorium.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Instead of practicing our usual cheer routines, I figured we could work on a custom one for Ben's Inauguration!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We'll do a couple of stunts... And then we'll all shout something nice, either about Ben... Or about me!
In a corner, the nerds are setting up some equipment...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why are the nerds here after school? Don't they normally play Ogres 'N' Elves?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, I had Ben make them stay and help out with the preparation...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You know, lighting, fireworks, and of course, a nerdy control room thing for the video presentation I'll be airing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Video presentation?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just something to showcase my ideas for Ben to implement... There are, like, `a lot` of wasteful school programs he can cut...
nodes.text_bbcode: Just something to showcase my ideas for Ben to implement... There are, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot[/i][/color] of wasteful school programs he can cut...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Like anyone actually `enjoys` Puppy Fridays!
nodes.text_bbcode: Like anyone actually [color=#3b78e2][i]enjoys[/i][/color] Puppy Fridays!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I do! It's my favorite day... Every week!
Anger rises up once again within $ZOE! She tries to suppress it, but the longer she holds it inside her, the harder it becomes to contain!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep! Gotta go!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What? Where are you going?!
$ZOE flees the auditorium...
...Sprints through the temporary cafeteria...
...And runs into the restroom, where she slams the door behind her, closes her eyes, and...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It won't be that bad...
At lunch...
$ZOE overhears a conversation at the swim team table...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I can't believe she's already cut off our funding! She isn't even the President! Actually, come to think of it, `Ben` isn't even President yet!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe she's already cut off our funding! She isn't even the President! Actually, come to think of it, [color=#3b78e2][i]Ben[/i][/color] isn't even President yet!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Imagine how it's going to be when he `is.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Imagine how it's going to be when he [color=#3b78e2][i]is.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess we'll be wearing the same swimsuits again next year...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And I have a sick feeling that Nick's photo lab money will be cut too...
Jessica sits down next to $ZOE at the Center Table, grinning from ear-to-ear!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So! Get! This!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Tomorrow, Ben and I are going to be flown to this luncheon with the mayor...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Naturally, `everyone's` going to be there! Hawk Gunner! Lisa what's-her-name! Oh, and did I mention... Hawk! Gunner?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Naturally, [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone's[/i][/color] going to be there! Hawk Gunner! Lisa what's-her-name! Oh, and did I mention... Hawk! Gunner?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I am `way` jealous. If you weren't my best friend, I spread `so` many nasty rumors about you on The Dirty Dish!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] jealous. If you weren't my best friend, I spread [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] many nasty rumors about you on The Dirty Dish!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I hate that website! It's so malicious and...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Jill?! Hello?! First Lady talking here!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway... I'm using my new clothing fund so Ben and I can look our best for the mayor! Isn't this totes great, everyone?
The anger returns to $ZOE, but once again she...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Fine! I've heard enough...
Steph rolls her chair over to a desk and pulls out a USB drive.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Once I saw how suspicious Jessica was, I got pretty diligent about recording our conversations...
She plugs the USB drive in and queues up a video...
As $ZOE and Taylor watch...
They get angrier and angrier...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I think this is probably enough evidence for you to bust Jessica with, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, let's get this to the Inauguration!
Backstage at the Inauguration, the lights flip on!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Finally! All it took was `every` nerd in the school! Are you ready to go out there, Ben?
nodes.text_bbcode: Finally! All it took was [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] nerd in the school! Are you ready to go out there, Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: As ready as I'm going to be!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't worry, you're going to be `totes` amazing!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry, you're going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]totes[/i][/color] amazing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I want to make sure everyone knows you endorse me when I present my video, so make sure to introduce me after your opening comments, okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I will...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great! Good luck!
Jessica gives Ben a kiss, and Ben steps out onto the stage...
The students applaud! Ben goes out to the podium...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My fellow... Ahem...
Jessica flashes him a smile from the side of the stage...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My fellow friends...
Meanwhile, $ZOE and Taylor arrive at the video control room.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What are you two doing back here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've got evidence against Jessica!
Taylor holds up the USB drive.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can we switch it out with Jessica's video?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That would be epic! Incredible! An unbelievable coup!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Enough, Captain Thesaurus!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No... We can't do it...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?! How can you `not` do something technical?! You're nerds!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! How can you [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] do something technical?! You're nerds!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Every one of you knows how to triangulate signals, hack mainframes, and code programs!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm impressed, sweetie. You've really boned up on your nerd terms.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks! I've been paying attention.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We really don't have time for banter, guys!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why can't we switch the video?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Jessica had us set up her laptop to play the video, but it's password protected. None of us knows her password...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Seriously?! We did all this, and we're going to fail because of a dumb password!
While Taylor agonizes, $ZOE sits down in front of Jessica's laptop...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica isn't very computer-savvy. I bet her password is something simple... Something she can remember...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know it!
Taylor and the nerds come over to where $ZOE's sitting...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I thought you said you knew it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought I did! Hold on... Just let me think...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's probably something she `says` a lot...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's probably something she [color=#3b78e2][i]says[/i][/color] a lot...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, yeah, random guessing and `eventually` you'll get it right! There are only like 100 or so possible passwords.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, yeah, random guessing and [color=#3b78e2][i]eventually[/i][/color] you'll get it right! There are only like 100 or so possible passwords.

nodes.text: The nerds share uneasy glances with each other...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was thinking it might be something simple... Like something she says a lot.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really? You had that idea, and you couldn't get it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not a good speller, okay!
Taylor types in the word 'Totes'.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're in! I hacked the mainframe!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That's not really a main...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ahem!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Uh, good job, Taylor...
$ZOE types in 'Totes'.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You did it! You hacked the mainframe!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That's not really a main...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ahem!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Uh, I mean, good job hacking the, uh, the mainframe, $ZOE!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!
$ZOE plugs in the USB drive, copies the file, and waits as it begins to transfer from Steph's USB drive to Jessica's laptop!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh! Why do we have to wait when there's so much technology here?!
On stage, Ben wraps up his speech...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thank you, everyone! For your votes! And your support!
The audience cheers!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Before I'm officially sworn in as President, my First Lady, Jessica, would like to say a few words and present you all with an informative video...
The lights dim as Jessica steps onto the stage, and the applause immediately dies. She stands behind the podium, a wide grin on her face...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thank you so `so` much for coming today!
nodes.text_bbcode: Thank you so [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much for coming today!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wanted to use Ben's Inauguration as a springboard for some of the changes I'd personally like to implement as First Lady...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Obviously, in order for Ben and I to look our very best, we'll need to free up some money, and that means, `regrettably`, cutting a few wasteful programs...
nodes.text_bbcode: Obviously, in order for Ben and I to look our very best, we'll need to free up some money, and that means, [color=#3b78e2][i]regrettably[/i][/color], cutting a few wasteful programs...

nodes.text: A murmur spreads throughout the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Clubs like... Football Band...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Music helps me play better!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I'm finally learning the oboe!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Obviously, I'll be getting rid of Eriks Who Love Paul Revere. No-brainer there.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Awww... I was the Vice President!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Why not President if you were the only member?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Too much power, Ashley, too much power.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ahem! And of course I'll be cutting Auto Shop completely, since no one ever uses that place.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey! We use it!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, we're in there all the time!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Like, I said... `No one` ever uses that place!
nodes.text_bbcode: Like, I said... [color=#3b78e2][i]No one[/i][/color] ever uses that place!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You can't take away Auto Shop, Jessica! That's our home... And the place where we fantasize about making out with you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Gross! I'll definitely be cutting it now!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Consider this a warning to everyone at this school! And if that wasn't clear enough...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Check out this totes awesome video I made!
A video plays on a huge screen behind Jessica's head...
Back in the control room...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?! How long does this take?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's ready!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Play it, $ZOE! Before Jessica's video airs!
$ZOE's finger hovers over the 'Enter' key... Time slows down, nearly stopping. In this moment, a voice inside her speaks...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to do this? You're a nice person, and you're about to destroy Jessica, which isn't a very nice thing to do...
Then, all the evil that Jessica's done flashes through $ZOE's brain!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It was $ZOE who played the tape! And it was $ZOE who cheated on Howard in France!
Denni pushes back from the table and storms out of Ben's house!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What just happened?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's pretty obvious. All this attention... Your rise in popularity...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's made her super, super insecure!
Ben pushes Jessica away and stares at her. Jessica feigns shock.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, you... You totally kissed me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't understand... How does shopping help me get over Denni?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shh! As long as you're under my guidance, we don't mention her name, okay?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, you might not like it at first, but hear me out...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is like the perfect time to give you a makeover!
Jessica brushes past $ZOE, lowering her voice.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This may have worked `one` time, but you'd better stay in line... Or I'll find a way to make you stay there!
nodes.text_bbcode: This may have worked [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] time, but you'd better stay in line... Or I'll find a way to make you stay there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That top post is a log of my texts with Nick! It's all stolen from my phone!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're supposed to be only for me and him!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There's no way I'm going to Kingston now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you waiting for, $ZOE?! Jessica's video's airing right now! Press the button!
There is no more hesitation in $ZOE...
She re-locks Jessica's computer, quickly setting up a new password.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you doing? We `just` hacked the mainframe! Why are you setting it back up?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you doing? We [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] hacked the mainframe! Why are you setting it back up?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We can't stoop to Jessica's level, Taylor. We'll end up becoming just like her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're just coming to this conclusion `now?!` Are you insane?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're just coming to this conclusion [color=#3b78e2][i]now?![/i][/color] Are you insane?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought of all the things Jessica's done, and I just couldn't bear the idea that I'd ever do something even remotely on her level.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sometimes the best way to fight evil is to be passive... The monster will walk right past you...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, and sometimes the monster eats everything in its path including you and everyone you love!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sometimes the best way to fight evil is to `actually` fight evil!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sometimes the best way to fight evil is to [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] fight evil!

nodes.text: Andrew whispers to Dex...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You getting this? Two hot chicks are fighting right in front of us! About fictional monsters! Whilst surrounded by technology!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Are you kidding? I've never blogged so fiercely!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fighting isn't the answer, Taylor. Passive resistance is!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, you can go sit in the corner and be passive while I switch the videos!
Taylor tries to get to Jessica's laptop, but $ZOE blocks her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey!
Taylor pushes $ZOE's chair, rolling her out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey!
As Taylor tries to guess $ZOE's password, $ZOE leaps out of her chair, grabbing at Taylor's hair!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Girls! Stop fighting!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Brendan! Shut up!
The girls struggle, falling to the ground! Taylor puts $ZOE in a headlock!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fighting me isn't very passive, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you seemed like the kind of monster that would eat my loved ones!
Andrew holds up his phone, filming the fight.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: New greatest day. This afternoon, I saw a pillow fight at Centerscore U. And now, `this!`
nodes.text_bbcode: New greatest day. This afternoon, I saw a pillow fight at Centerscore U. And now, [color=#e23b3b][i]this![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Meanwhile, Jessica's video plays uninterrupted...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Imagine what next year will be like...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Instead of clubs with no purpose...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Or money going toward programs no one cares about...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We'll have parties, like, all the time!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's going to be `totes` the best!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]totes[/i][/color] the best!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thanks for voting for Ben, everyone! It's like you voted for me!
Definitely not the ending $ZOE wanted! You must play again and see if you can put an end to Jessica's tyranny!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For everyone you've hurt... All the damage you've caused... It's over, Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Totes` over.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Totes[/i][/color] over.

lines.text: $ZOE presses the 'Enter' button.
Meanwhile, on the screen above Jessica, her video plays...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Imagine what next year will be like...
...The video feed is interrupted! The screen turns to static!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Uh... Technical difficulties...
The image shifts and shows Jessica talking to Steph in her computer lab...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Uh...
The crowd starts booing...

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: So on the last night of the election, you want me to hack the system and add in a bunch of votes for this Ben guy?

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Why do you keep repeating everything like that? Yes! Duh!

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: And why would I help you out? You're a Lizard!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Because I'll use my political weight as First Lady to leech all the funding from stupid sports programs, except for cheerleading, of course...

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Why do I care?

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: I really have to spell it out? Gah! You Wilson idiots really `are` stupid!
lines.text_bbcode: I really have to spell it out? Gah! You Wilson idiots really [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] stupid!

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Thanks, no offense taken!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: None given!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Without funding, we'll lose, like, `every` game to Wilson High.
lines.text_bbcode: Without funding, we'll lose, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] game to Wilson High.

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: That does sound like a sweet deal...

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Do you really have that much influence?

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: You have no idea... I can pretty much get Ben to do `whatever` I want.
lines.text_bbcode: You have no idea... I can pretty much get Ben to do [color=#3b78e2][i]whatever[/i][/color] I want.

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: You should have seen how easy it was to get him to break up with his lame hipster ex-girlfriend. It was like a baby `gave` me candy!
lines.text_bbcode: You should have seen how easy it was to get him to break up with his lame hipster ex-girlfriend. It was like a baby [color=#3b78e2][i]gave[/i][/color] me candy!

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Well, then... I'm in!
Static fills the screen... For one moment, the auditorium is stunned, silent.

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Ha! What a great April Fool's joke that was, wasn't it?
$ZOE and Taylor leap onto the stage!

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: It's no April Fool's joke! Jessica rigged the election! She used Steph to run the Dirty Dish, too!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: `You!`
lines.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You![/i][/color]

lines.text: The crowd boos!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: This is all a misunderstanding!
$ZOE and Taylor step toward Jessica! She turns to flee the stage...
But stops when she sees...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Ben!
Ben stands in front of her, his jaw taut...

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: You used me.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: You `used` me.
lines.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]used[/i][/color] me.

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Fine, yeah, I did! I used you. I knew I could turn you into the President, and I wanted all the perks of being the First Lady...

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Perks?! You `broke` me and Denni up for `perks?!`
lines.text_bbcode: Perks?! You [color=#e23b3b][i]broke[/i][/color] me and Denni up for [color=#e23b3b][i]perks?![/i][/color]

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: I did...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: I'm sorry for that...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: I deceived you, but Ben...
Jessica steps forward and raises her hand to caress Ben's face, but he stops her!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Don't you dare. You don't get to touch me ever again.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Was everything fake?!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: My feelings were real, Ben.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: No, they weren't. You have to be human first to have feelings.

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: What are you saying?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Did you ever stop for even one moment to think that what you were doing was wrong?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: When you were betraying me, hurting Denni, and throwing all of Twin Branches under the bus!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Do you have a conscience?!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: No... You don't... You don't care about anyone but yourself...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Come on, Ben. You know I'm not like that. You know I love you...

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I don't know that because it isn't true. This isn't love... This is just lies and poison!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I thought I knew you... I thought I loved you... But I don't love this Jessica... The `real` Jessica... The `real` you.
lines.text_bbcode: I thought I knew you... I thought I loved you... But I don't love this Jessica... The [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] Jessica... The [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] you.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: And I don't `ever` want to see you again!
lines.text_bbcode: And I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] want to see you again!

lines.text: As the crowd continues to boo, food flies from the audience and onto the stage at Jessica... She flees...
Amid the chaos, Ben and Denni lock eyes... Neither sure of what the other is thinking...
$ZOE gets behind the podium...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I know it's hard, but please try to calm down everyone... Please, could you just calm down? Guys? Please...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: `Please!`
lines.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Please![/i][/color]

lines.text: The auditorium falls silent.

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I think I know Ben well enough to say that he doesn't want to win the election this way.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I don't...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I'm also proud to know how much all of you actually care about who your President is... Enough to riot like this!

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: Enough to vote and campaign for them!

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: That's why I'm going to personally make sure that all the votes you cast get counted, so that we can declare an official President in just a few weeks!
Applause fills the auditorium!

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: And on one, final note...
$ZOE looks at Taylor.

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: Value the friendships you have. They rarely last forever. They can often come from nowhere, but when you find them... Treasure them.
The audience applauds...

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: With Jessica gone, I think $ZOE should step in as the new Head Cheerleader!

lines.speaker: Hector
lines.text: Yeah! $ZOE!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Woo! $ZOE for Head Cheerleader!

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: But I already voted for Pony!
One by one the cheerleaders call out for $ZOE to become the Head Cheerleader...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I'm... I'm so flattered... I... I...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I accept!
The crowd cheers!
Congratulations! You played a great game!
You helped $ZOE express her anger, follow the trail of evidence that led to Jessica's demise, and become the Head Cheerleader!
You became the New Girl, Unleashed!
Before we tally your score, remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam! If you're lucky, you can even Tweet with Amanda!
You have unlocked the bonus scene! Enjoy!
Achieving a grade of A or higher will unlock a special bonus scene!
Taylor sits at the Center Table for the first time in months...

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Are you a new student?

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: Hi, Amanda.
Brendan sits down next to Taylor...

lines.speaker: Brendan
lines.text: Never sat here before!

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.text: Two nerds at the Center Table? Jessica, tell them how that's...

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.text: Oh, right... Never mind.

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: What's the matter, Nicole? Lost your buddy?

lines.speaker: Hector
lines.text: So are you guys gonna sit with us now? No more Nerd Table?

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: We decided it'd be good for me to have more exposure to cool people.

lines.speaker: Brendan
lines.text: So we're going to alternate days! Now, you might be wondering how that works given that there are five days in the school week, an unfortunately odd number.

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: Brendan! What'd I tell you before we sat here?

lines.speaker: Brendan
lines.text: No nerd talk at the cool table.

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: Brendan
lines.text: Oh, right... Uh, any cool parties coming up?

lines.speaker: Carson
lines.text: Only the best party ever!

lines.speaker: Hector
lines.text: Uh, probably want to get a different phrase... We've used that one a lot.

lines.speaker: Carson
lines.text: Only the `hottest` party ever!
lines.text_bbcode: Only the [color=#e23b3b][i]hottest[/i][/color] party ever!

lines.speaker: Hector
lines.text: Carson and I have been planning something so awesome, it will blow your minds!

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: I'm immune to mind-blowing!
As Hector and Carson lay out their party plan, $ZOE can't contain her excitement...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: `Head` Cheerleader! Next year is going to be amazing! I can't wait!
lines.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Head[/i][/color] Cheerleader! Next year is going to be amazing! I can't wait!

lines.speaker: Howard
lines.text: Yeah, amazing...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: Oh, Howard... I'm sorry. I forgot that you won't be here...

lines.speaker: Howard
lines.text: What do you think we should do?

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I don't know... We can't ignore the fact that you're graduating...

lines.speaker: Howard
lines.text: No, we can't.

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: It's going to happen.
Howard grabs $ZOE's hand and squeezes it.
Meanwhile, out in the parking lot...

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: All right, Princess, I can't stand it. Hit me with the bad news.

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: You and Tweed. Jessica broke you up. Just get it over with, and tell me what we both know is going on.

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Actually, I think this is a rare case in which only you know what's going on...

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Are you leaving me for Ben?
Denni punches Colt in the shoulder.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Ow! Hey!

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: I'm with you, Doofus.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Tell me the thought hadn't crossed your mind now that you know Jessica's responsible for what happened.

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: It... It did, actually.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: I knew it!

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Relax... I mean... There was a moment in the auditorium when we looked at each other...

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: That son of a...

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Colt! He wasn't giving me `the look!` He was just looking at me, okay?
lines.text_bbcode: Colt! He wasn't giving me [color=#3b78e2][i]the look![/i][/color] He was just looking at me, okay?

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: I don't know the difference.

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: I know you don't. But, listen, okay... We looked at each other, and there was nothing there.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: What? Really?

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Yeah, it's like... So much time has passed... Ben and I are over. He's the past. `You're` my future.
lines.text_bbcode: Yeah, it's like... So much time has passed... Ben and I are over. He's the past. [color=#3b78e2][i]You're[/i][/color] my future.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Can I still beat him up a little? For looking at you, I mean?

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: No! If you beat up every guy who looked at me, you'd be beating up `a lot` of guys!
lines.text_bbcode: No! If you beat up every guy who looked at me, you'd be beating up [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot[/i][/color] of guys!

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Really? What are their names?

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Wow. You're incorrigible.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Hey! You're a... Dirigible. Didn't think I knew that word, did you?

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: You got me there, baby.
And somewhere very far away... Jessica looks at the schedule of classes at her new school...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: What kind of school is this? Ice fishing? Walrus identification?

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: Helllllooooooooo! Oh how much I enjoy your hair! Enough grease to hold a flame for many days!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Oh no...

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: Do you see the way we are looking? We are twins! Like seahorses galloping across oceans in search of our aqua-equine matings!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Why are you talking to me?

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: You are Jessica, no? The fattest whale of my former school!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: By this I mean you were the most desirable and popular...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Oh, totes! I `am` Jessica!
lines.text_bbcode: Oh, totes! I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] Jessica!

lines.text: Astrid checks over her shoulders...

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: Then I have a message for you...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: You want to help me rule this school?
Astrid reaches into her jacket and pulls out a steaming cup of coffee!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Wha?
She tosses it on Jessica!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: `Ack!`
lines.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ack![/i][/color]

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: That is for mistreating my friends!
Looks like Taylor's finding that healthy balance between nerd and cool, $ZOE and Howard have to deal with Howard's impending graduation...
Denni and Colt are going to be fine...
But Jessica has a long, scalding hot future ahead of her!
Hope you enjoyed your bonus scene!
What will cheerleading be like with $ZOE in command? Stay tuned for the next season of Surviving High School...

nodes.text: $ZOE nods at Taylor...
Taylor dumps the water bottle out over the computer! Sparks shoot out! `Krrrzerp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor dumps the water bottle out over the computer! Sparks shoot out! [b]Krrrzerp![/b]

nodes.text: The machine goes dark!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Are you crazy?!
Taylor swipes her arm across the desk, sending a bunch of the machines crashing to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe you want to just tell us what you know?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Or... How about now I'm `never` going to tell you because you just damaged several thousand dollars worth of computer equipment!
nodes.text_bbcode: Or... How about now I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] going to tell you because you just damaged several thousand dollars worth of computer equipment!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not what I was hoping to hear...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Then you'll really like to hear that the school will be suing you too!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't we have immunity or something?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: How? How could you possibly be immune from being sued for destroying these computers?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You suck, that's how?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure you're not lying?
Steph confidently folds her hands behind her head.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I'm sure I'm not lying...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, if you say so, then we can only assume you're telling the truth.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I guess I am...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So then, I guess we'll be going...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I guess you will...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look, Steph, you don't know what Jessica's capable of...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But based on what `we` know, it's a pretty safe bet that she promised you something...
nodes.text_bbcode: But based on what [color=#3b78e2][i]we[/i][/color] know, it's a pretty safe bet that she promised you something...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Trust us... She isn't going to follow through on that promise!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: She does seem `really` shady...
nodes.text_bbcode: She does seem [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] shady...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Understatement! She's so shady she's, like... Underneath a tree!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sorry, that wasn't very clever...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But she `is` shady! She rigged the election just so she could reap all the benefits of being First Lady!
nodes.text_bbcode: But she [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] shady! She rigged the election just so she could reap all the benefits of being First Lady!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Don't care.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She broke up a couple just to get what she wanted!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I `really` don't care.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] don't care.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She made my boyfriend and his friends work after school... When we were all going to play Ogres 'N' Elves together!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: What? Why would she do that? Ogres 'N' Elves time is sacred!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not to her, Steph. Not to her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want to believe you, Steph... I do...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I don't.
$ZOE nods at Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Oh and what is Princess going to do?
Taylor takes out a bottle of water from her purse, unscrews it, and holds it over one of the machines.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Whoa! Whoa! Whoa! Okay, okay! I might have rigged the election too!
Taylor tilts out a drop of water onto the machine... A wisp of smoke fizzles up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tell us something we don't know!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Paula seemed to think that you might have evidence against Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Maybe I do, maybe I don't...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We know that Paula said she referred Jessica to you...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Oh, well...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Why didn't you just say so in the first place?!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because I'm trying to give you a chance to come clean. Otherwise...
$ZOE nods at Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think I can control her...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Yeah, okay, Jessica came to me for help, but I didn't do anything!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I just set up The Dirty Dish, that's it... I don't know anything about an election!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're lying!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I'm not lying!
Taylor takes out a bottle of water from her purse, unscrews it, and holds it over one of the machines.
Backstage at the Inauguration, Ben paces back and forth, his hands shaking as he practices his speech...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My beloved Centerscorians, er... Twin Branchites, er... This is hopeless!
Jessica comes in through the curtain.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How are you doing, President Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nervous. Really `really` nervous! How does it look out there?
nodes.text_bbcode: Nervous. Really [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] nervous! How does it look out there?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's a packed house. Almost showtime!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Gulp.` I don't know why I asked... I'm never going to be a good President!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Gulp.[/i][/color] I don't know why I asked... I'm never going to be a good President!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Listen, Ben...
Jessica takes Ben's hand as he walks by. He stops pacing and looks at her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I've never been more proud of you than I am right now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why? I haven't really done anything...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You transformed yourself, you went from a nerdy no-name with `unbearably` googly eyes to the super hot guy standing in front of me right now...
nodes.text_bbcode: You transformed yourself, you went from a nerdy no-name with [color=#3b78e2][i]unbearably[/i][/color] googly eyes to the super hot guy standing in front of me right now...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're Ben Kale! A patriot in the Spartan Games, a hero in the earthquake, and now, a totes cute President!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You've always been so good to me...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, Ben... You've been good to me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I haven't always been the nicest girl, but you've stuck with me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And whenever I started to stray from the right path...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You were, like, `right there...` To keep me honest.
nodes.text_bbcode: You were, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]right there...[/i][/color] To keep me honest.

nodes.text: Ben puts a strand of Jessica's hair behind her ear.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I love you, Jess.
Tears well up in Jessica's eyes...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I love you too, Ben.
A tear starts to fall down her cheek. Ben catches it on his finger.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Remember when we first dated, we were at your house, and we looked at your tears through my pocket microscope...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How could I forget that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Those were a different kind of tears then, weren't they?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Completely. I'm a much happier girl today...
Jessica wraps her arms around Ben, and they kiss...
Just then...
The lights go out! Jessica separates herself from Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Again?! Seriously, I've got every nerd in the school working here, and we can't keep the stupid lights on!
Jessica storms off in the direction of the video control room...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess that gives me more time to work on my speech...
Behind a nearby curtain, Denni uses the darkness to dispose a pair of wire cutters...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I hope my little act of sabotage gives $ZOE and Taylor a few more minutes to find evidence against Jessica! Come on, guys! Where are you?
On the Wilson High campus, $ZOE and Taylor manage to track Steph down to the Wilson High computer lab...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: You guys are lucky it's so late in the day... Otherwise, you would have been punked just for showing your pathetic faces around here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's nice to see you too.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are `you` doing here this late?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here this late?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I pretty much live here...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: There aren't many nerds at Wilson. The school's computer lab is really just `my` computer lab. So you're kind of all up in my personal space right now...
nodes.text_bbcode: There aren't many nerds at Wilson. The school's computer lab is really just [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] computer lab. So you're kind of all up in my personal space right now...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: By the way, that means `get out.`
nodes.text_bbcode: By the way, that means [color=#3b78e2][i]get out.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Taylor whispers under her breath to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good cop, bad cop...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's on...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think it's pretty obvious that of the two of us, I'm the good cop!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just have to choose the right moments to either be nice or to let Taylor step in and be mean!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Steph, we know you helped Jessica run The Dirty Dish and rig the election.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: You don't `know` anything!
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] anything!

nodes.text: Anger rises up once again within $ZOE! She tries to suppress it, but the longer she holds it inside her, the harder it becomes to contain!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep! Gotta go!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What? Where are you going?!
$ZOE flees the auditorium...
...Sprints through the temporary cafeteria...
...And runs into the restroom, where she slams the door behind her, closes her eyes, and...
When she opens her eyes again, she sees Taylor staring at her wide-eyed, standing in front of the mirror...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shut. Up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I didn't know you had that in you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't either!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let me guess... Jessica?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've got to take her down, Taylor! She might have beat us in the election, but I'm not done fighting!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I was thinking the exact same thing... And `not` because I lost to Ben... But because all day I've been hearing people say that they voted for someone else!
nodes.text_bbcode: I was thinking the exact same thing... And [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] because I lost to Ben... But because all day I've been hearing people say that they voted for someone else!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If so many people didn't vote for Ben, how did he win by a landslide?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Something smells fishy...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It does smell fishy in here. It's kinda gross. Probably the fishsticks from the kitchen coming in through the ventilation system...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I meant with the election!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, well, yeah!
At that moment, Denni bursts into the bathroom, slams the door behind her, closes her eyes, and...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: When she opens her eyes, she sees $ZOE and Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes! She's the worst! You guys are fed up with her too?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a rapidly growing club...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How'd she get to you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I was going over the voting trends for this article I promised Jessica I'd write for her...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Don't` ask. It's a favor from a long time ago...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Don't[/i][/color] ask. It's a favor from a long time ago...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Anyway, the numbers just didn't make sense!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The vote was in a dead heat all the way to the end... And then right before the polls closed, a ton of votes for Ben poured in!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sure Jessica rigged the election somehow, but I don't have any evidence.  So instead of exposing her, I'm doing the exact opposite...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: She's got me writing a fluff piece about how amazing she and Ben are!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know. Kill me now, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys, we need to get evidence against Jessica! Otherwise, she's going to make all our lives miserable!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great plan, $ZOE! Let's just head on down to the evidence store and pick us up a big old bag of evidence!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry! Do you have a better idea?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Naturally! We could write, like, a computer program that analyzed everything that Jessica's done up to now! The computer will lead us right to the evidence!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: A computer program? Really? I didn't think I'd be saying this... But `evidence store` sounds like the most plausible idea.
nodes.text_bbcode: A computer program? Really? I didn't think I'd be saying this... But [color=#3b78e2][i]evidence store[/i][/color] sounds like the most plausible idea.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine! That wasn't perfect, but how about this idea? We `role-play` as Jessica. Then, we'll, like, know how she thinks!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! That wasn't perfect, but how about this idea? We [color=#3b78e2][i]role-play[/i][/color] as Jessica. Then, we'll, like, know how she thinks!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I assumed you already thought like her, but that's becoming less and less certain the more you speak...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, I used to be so good at being devious... What happened?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's it! That's the key! Taylor's gotten too nerdy to scheme the way Jessica does!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If only I could somehow trigger the `old` Taylor, I bet `she` could come up with a better plan!
nodes.text_bbcode: If only I could somehow trigger the [color=#3b78e2][i]old[/i][/color] Taylor, I bet [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] could come up with a better plan!

nodes.text: $ZOE takes a deep breath...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry for what I'm about to say, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, Taylor, maybe you'd be better at being devious if you...
Later, as $ZOE and Taylor are leaving the school...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We messed that interrogation up, didn't we?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Or `you` did!
nodes.text_bbcode: Or [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] did!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess all we can do now is head back to the school...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And watch the Inauguration...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And see Jessica `win...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And see Jessica [color=#3b78e2][i]win...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Zoe has failed...
